caption: The drawing depicts two ornate spoons laid out horizontally, one above the other, both viewed from above. Each spoon features a rounded bowl and an elongated handle. The upper spoon is shown with intricate floral and leafy patterns inscribed on both the bowl and the handle, with a crosshatch texture extending along the handle. The lower spoon also has decorative floral motifs within the bowl, but its handle is smooth and tapers gently outward into a rounded end, with stamped markings visible on the upper part of the handle. The main illustration is rendered in fine black lines on a cream-colored background. In the lower left corner, there is an inset technical drawing of the spoon, showing its profile and dimensions, labeled with measurements and the scale noted as 1:1. The artist's signature appears in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Silver Spoon
